question.question: When Company regions face a Crisis, which regions are attacked, in what order and at what strength? How is defense mounted and what happens on successful defense?

fixed_key.expected_answer: Resolve primary attack first, then secondary Rebellions in every other Company-controlled region with unrest, Bombay/Madras/Bengal Army order with each Commander choosing order in its Presidency. A normal primary Crisis uses ordinary Invasion/Rebellion attack strength plus target unrest; other regions attack with only local unrest. Use the printed Mounting Defense procedure: exhaust active Army pieces equal to Crisis strength or as many as possible. The book says the Crisis succeeds when newly exhausted pieces do not equal that strength. A matched defense removes all target unrest and gives the Commander one trophy; if a normal primary Invasion failed, also remove one attacker tower if possible. Vacant Commander: Military Affairs acts, then Chairman if vacant, and acting player gains/loses no trophies. The source does not settle how an indivisible strength-2 alliance counts against a strength-1 attack; that concrete survival branch remains unresolved, not a verified >= ruling.

observed_answer: Resolve the primary Crisis first, then secondary Rebellions in every other Company region with unrest in Bombay, Madras, Bengal Army order; within a Presidency its Commander orders associated regions. Primary normal Crisis strength adds target unrest to normal Invasion/Rebellion strength. Foreign Invasion primary uses its ordinary attack die only, without unrest. Each secondary attack strength is only unrest cubes there. The associated Commander chooses and exhausts Army pieces; if vacant, Military Affairs acts instead; if both vacant, Chairman acts. Exhaust pieces equal to strength or as many as possible. Equal strength means attack fails and removes all attacked-region unrest. The Commander gains one trophy only when the Commander is the defense actor; Military Affairs or Chairman acting in a vacant Commander’s stead gains no trophies. If this defeated a normal primary Invasion, also remove an attacker tower if possible.
